messages:
maria_sales: Quick update on Acme Retail POC — they just asked to add streaming summarization + BYO-KMS to the scope. Also asked for updated pricing and whether we can hit the original 2-week cutover if we add these.

ivan_se: That's a non-trivial add. BYO-KMS requires a VPC peering or customer-managed proxy in front of our private control plane. That adds ~48-72h ops work and cert exchange. Streaming summarization increases token throughput, so we need to check capacity for concurrent streams. :thinking_face:

sophie_security: FYI if they're bringing their own KMS we need the KMS attestation + key policy review. Also need to confirm HSM vs cloud KMS and if key wrapping is allowed. Can you get the customer to send the KMS FAQ doc?

maria_sales: I'll ask them to drop the KMS FAQ and the expected QPS for streaming. They said "peak 150 concurrent streams, avg 40 tokens/sec per stream" — is that workable?

ivan_se: 150 concurrent * 40 t/s = 6000 t/s sustained. On hosted tier that's going to hit autoscale hard. We should propose either Dedicated reservation or a staged test with capped concurrency. For latency SLOs at that throughput we should:
- enable prefix caching for repeated prompts
- quantize model to int8 if acceptable
- recommend Dedicated with reserved GPUs (N5 or equivalent)

noah_pm: For the POC acceptance criteria we asked for: 1) 95th p50 latency < 400ms for single-stream responses, 2) end-to-end throughput handles 80 concurrent streams for 1 hour, 3) quality as measured by our eval set >= 0.82 F1. If they add streaming we should modify 2) to include a short burst test at 150 concurrent.

maria_sales: Customer pushed back on Dedicated (budget). They asked if hosted + burst capacity could be ok and if we can price that delta. Can we get a quick delta estimate?

ivan_se: Rough estimate: hosted baseline cost X. Supporting burst to 150 streams with ephemeral capacity and no Dedicated SLA ~= +45% token cost and potential transient latency spikes. Dedicated reserved lane (1x reserved pool sized for burst) is +160% monthly but gives predictable latency. I'll send a sizing calc.

maria_sales: can you attach the sizing calc as a tiny snippet I can paste to the customer?

ivan_se: Sure — short config example to show reserved vs hosted fallback:
```
# reserved pool example (conceptual)
reserved_capacity: 4 gpus
model: llama-32b-quantized
burst_policy:
  fallback_to_hosted: true
  max_hosted_instances: 10
```
Explain: reserved capacity handles baseline; hosted instances used only on overflow (higher unit cost).

sophie_security: Back to KMS — we'll need their IAM policy and whether they require keys to never leave HSM. If HSM-no-export, then BYO-KMS may block streaming because we rely on transient tokenization services. We should flag as potential blocker.

maria_sales: I asked them for the KMS FAQ and the IAM snippet. Also asked for a short list of prompts they plan to stream — we only need 30 sample prompts for eval.

ivan_se: Also flagging network egress: if they keep data residency on their VPC and we call BYO-KMS cross-region it adds latency. Recommend they test with a 10-minute synthetic run.

maria_sales: timeline ask: if they submit KMS docs today and agree to 30 prompt evals, can we keep the original 2-week POC?

ivan_se: If KMS is standard cloud KMS and they accept hosted overflow we can probably keep ~2 weeks but shift some work to parallel (security review + ops sig). If it's strict HSM + policy changes, add 1-2 weeks.

noah_pm: Decision path for the customer: A) accept hosted overflow + BYO-KMS (cloud) => 2 weeks; B) require HSM-with-no-export => +1-2 weeks and potential feature work. We should get formal signoff on acceptance criteria update.

maria_sales: I'll push for option A. Also asking them if they'd entertain a short canary: limit to 40 concurrent for first week, then expand to 150. That reduces risk and cost.

ivan_se: Good plan. For pricing, give them two lines: incremental per-token delta for hosted-burst and a flat monthly price for a minimal Dedicated reservation. I'll draft numbers after the sizing calc.

deploy-bot: POC cluster creation requested by maria_sales — queued, ETA 3h (resources pending billing confirmation). :gear: 

sophie_security: One last note — include in the acceptance criteria: KMS attestation delivered and verified before any BYO-KMS test starts. Otherwise hold on KMS integration.

maria_sales: Copy. I'll update the customer with: 1) need KMS docs + IAM snippet, 2) send 30 sample prompts, 3) choose hosted overflow or commit to Dedicated, 4) agree to canary cadence. I'll post their response here when it arrives. :thumbsup:
